title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1997 The information received from 27 States/UTs shows that more than 20 types of vocational training were being imparted in the above States/UTs during the year 1997. Some of the trainings involve special skills and, therefore, the prison inmates are being trained in skilful vocations as per the facilities available in the prisons. From the information made available by the States/UTs, it is seen that the state of Andhra Pradesh had the provision for maximum number of (14 Nos) vocational training facilities in the jails located in the States. Other States/UTs which had more number of such training facilities were Maharashtra (11), Madhya Pradesh & Punjab (10 each), Karnataka (9), Gujarat and Rajasthan (8 each), Uttar Pradesh (6), Tripura (5) and Delhi (13).
